content.label: Voiskey has honestly changed the way I work. I just talk the way I naturally speak — fillers, stumbles, changing my mind mid-sentence — and it still comes out as clean, ready-to-send text. It even learned my names and jargon, so everything sounds like me. The AI-prompt mode is a killer feature: I describe what I want to build out loud, and it turns it into a structured prompt with files, paths, and commands. At 220+ wpm, it's genuinely 5x faster than my typing, and it works everywhere on my Mac in 100+ languages. Highly recommended!
